cohort: 339 women who delivered at the Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital in Accra, Ghana, between April 1, 2014 and March 31, 2015
finding: Women aged 40 years or older had a higher incidence of gestational diabetes, cesarean delivery, and venous thromboembolism (VTE) compared to women aged 20-34 years.
mod_finding: Women aged 40 years and older had a higher incidence of cesarean delivery (70.1% vs 57.1%, P=0.018) compared to younger women.
